cohort: 160 pregnant women in their third trimester, aged 20 years or older, from the three main Obstetrics and Gynecology departments in Gaza Strip, Palestine
finding: Low maternal dietary zinc intake was associated with a higher risk of pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH), and having PIH was associated with an increased risk of low birth weight and low Apgar scores.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2,904.6 ± 486 g for cases (PIH) and 3,128.3 ± 501 g for controls
